# Default configuration

**For:** operators. Every key FerroSMART reads with a default, at that default,
as the configuration tree holds it before a file, the environment or
`--set` change it. A table with no default, such as
`[[ferrosmart.upstream]]`, is absent here; [configuration](../configure/configuration.md)
and [upstream configuration](../configure/upstream-keys.md) describe every
key.

```toml
[server]
listen = "127.0.0.1:8080"
base_path = ""
request_timeout = "30s"
header_read_timeout = "30s"
idle_timeout = "2min"
body_limit = "1MiB"
drain_delay = "0s"
shutdown_timeout = "10s"
max_concurrent_requests = 256
max_waiting_requests = 256
admission_wait = "100ms"
retry_after = "1s"
trusted_proxies = []
forwarded_header = "forwarded"
compression = true
compression_min_size = "1KiB"
request_decompression = false

[telemetry]
format = "auto"
filter = "info,hyper=warn,tower=warn,h2=warn"
logged_query_parameters = []

[ferrosmart]
name = "FerroSMART"
issuer = ""
access_token_lifetime = "5min"
refresh_idle = "30d"
online_idle = "8h"
assurance_minimum = "substantial"
require_pushed_authorization_requests = false
resource = []
role = []

[ferrosmart.keys]
private_key_files = []
ps256_private_key_files = []
rotation_period = "90d"

[ferrosmart.database]
max_connections = 16

[ferrosmart.branding]
consent_text = ""
smart_style_url = ""

[ferrosmart.audit]
source_id = ""

[ferrosmart.registration]
open = false
scope = ""

[ferrosmart.picker]
recent_retention = "30d"
```
